title: Craps
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium casino catalogue title-card illustration.
Primary request: one polished, immediately recognizable Craps game key-art card.
Scene/backdrop: open rich emerald felt with a forest-green vignette, two restrained curved ivory/gold table lines without words or betting numbers, subtle antique-gold edge detail.
Subject: exactly TWO warm ivory casino dice captured in a gentle tumble just above the felt, clear cube geometry and softly rounded edges, small dark charcoal circular pips aligned correctly on each face. One die shows a top face with THREE pips in a diagonal, adjacent faces ONE and TWO. The other shows a top face with FOUR pips in a square, adjacent faces FIVE in a quincunx and SIX as two columns of three. Values 1/2/3 are adjacent on one cube and 4/5/6 adjacent on the other; do not repeat a value on adjacent faces, do not use seven or more pips on any face. Very soft short shadows anchor the dice, slight restrained motion emphasis. A small orderly stack of red and charcoal chips with white edge inserts is secondary.
Style/medium: premium professionally illustrated casino game key art, soft painted felt/ivory materials and crisp clean dice silhouettes, tasteful dimensional lighting and warm antique-gold typography. Refined, no photorealism, no explosion or gaudy glow.
Composition/framing: true wide 2:1 landscape canvas. Large title balanced beside the two dice across the middle, no overlap. Compact full composition occupying ONLY the central 70% width and 60% height, with quiet generous felt margins. Complete title and both whole dice fully inside central 80% width / 70% height. Keep all pips clear and the title readable at 256x128.
Text (verbatim): "Craps". Exactly once in large elegant crisp gold serif lettering. No other words or numerals outside the dice pips.
Constraints: exactly two dice, no cards, no hands or people, no fake interface, betting labels, buttons, currency, payout claims, slogans, watermark or logos. Opaque background. One image only.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected master and runtime export. Exact title and exactly two ivory dice, with correct distinct adjacent faces: 3/1/2 on one die and 4/5/6 on the other. Dark pips are aligned correctly, no invalid face counts. Restrained open felt lines and red/charcoal chips match current theme; no fake UI or payout language.
visualCheck.thumbnail: Inspected at 256x128. Craps remains readable and the two-dice silhouette and pips remain distinct.
visualCheck.crop: Complete title and both full dice sit inside central 80% width / 70% height. Secondary outer chip stacks and felt curves are expendable in responsive crops.
visualCheck.compression: WebP quality 84; 36,616 bytes, below 120 KB ideal target.
